name: PEMS-BAY: California Bay Area Highway Traffic Speed Benchmark
description: PEMS-BAY is a spatial-temporal traffic speed benchmark collected by the California Performance Measurement System (Caltrans PeMS) across the San Francisco Bay Area. Introduced for Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (DCRNN) evaluation, it comprises 6 months of continuous traffic speed measurements from 325 highway sensor stations sampled every 5 minutes from January 1 to June 30, 2017.

license.notes: The benchmark distribution repository code is released under the MIT License; underlying highway traffic sensor readings are open data made available by the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) Performance Measurement System (PeMS).
